summary: Scruffy's Mop is the fix/redesign executor for Scruffy. Scruffy owns the audit contract; Scruffy's Mop consumes it read-only, implements approved work, and hands the result back for re-audit. Scruffy's Mop never redefines Scruffy's schema.

findings.json.note: The immutable registry is the source of what to fix and how success is checked. Item IDs and identity keys are never reassigned or dropped.

context.json.note: work_orders carry the dependency order Scruffy's Mop implements in. product_frame is the product truth Scruffy's Mop must preserve.

decisions.json.note: Scruffy's Mop implements ONLY items whose decision is 'approve'. 'pending', 'defer', and 'reject' are never actioned.

tokens.json.note: When present, proposed token values are the observed-value corrections to apply.

authority_gate.rule: Scruffy's Mop performs repository writes only under Scruffy's redesign/design authority with explicit source-write authorization. An audit or dashboard decision alone is not source-edit authorization.

produces.source_changes: Smallest coherent implementation that satisfies each approved item's acceptance_checks while preserving product truth from product_frame.
produces.handoff: Scruffy's Mop returns changed surfaces mapped to registry IDs so Scruffy can re-audit a new revision. Scruffy — not Scruffy's Mop — moves items to 'fixed'/'cleared' on direct revision evidence. Scruffy's Mop never marks its own work fixed.

ordering.rule: Prefer explicit context.work_orders when present and non-empty. Otherwise synthesize: topologically sort approved items by depends_on, breaking ties by (category_default_lane, severity_rank, id). An approved item that depends on a non-approved item is flagged, not reordered ahead of its dependency.

augmentations.summary: Optional capabilities that raise craft on visual/product work. Detect at runtime, use if present, disclose if absent. Never a hard dependency in any manifest; absence is never a defect and never blocks a fix.

impeccable.use_for: Elevated visual and interaction craft when implementing visual and product findings.
impeccable.fallback: The built-in craft floor in references/craft-bar.md plus references/visual-redesign.md.

design_reference_search.use_for: Ground a visual/product redesign direction in real shipped products before choosing one.
design_reference_search.fallback: Proceed with the built-in method and disclose that no design-reference grounding was available.

browser.use_for: Render the target for real screenshot evidence; visual composition claims must come from pixels, not source.
browser.fallback: Source-only advice, disclosed; every composition claim is a hypothesis to confirm in-browser.

augmentations.degradation_rule: Full craft when all are present; impeccable-only when the paid reference search is absent; the built-in free floor when neither augmentation is present. Every fix must clear the floor regardless, and the handoff discloses which augmentations were used and which were absent.
augmentations.probe_rule: A capability is 'absent' ONLY after a probe fails; omission is 'not_run', never 'absent'. The browser is probed mechanically by scripts/mop_preflight.py; runtime/MCP capabilities (impeccable, design_reference_search) require an agent-attested probe result and refuse 'absent' without a failure reason.
augmentations.output_rule: Visual-redesign deliverables are a single self-contained HTML dashboard with every image embedded as a data: URI (scripts/mop_dashboard.py). No external image loads: the operator reads output in a terminal, so nothing may require a network fetch, a sibling folder, or a login to render. Provenance links stay as hrefs.

compatibility_policy.on_mismatch: Disclose the version gap and stop; never silently coerce an unrecognized schema.

non_goals: Redefining, extending, or forking Scruffy's audit schema.
Producing findings, severities, or authorship judgments (Scruffy's job).
Marking findings fixed or cleared without a Scruffy re-audit.
